name: ash
description: ASH engineering skills: 50 guardrail skills in a four-layer architecture (hooks, norms, hubs, leaves), distilled from cross-repo lessons learned and committee-ratified. Includes the Layer 0 hooks (push gate, skill fire log, destructive-SQL warn, secret-echo guard, session recon, schedule-cost warn) and the always-on norms injected at session start. Also ships reviewer agents, one of them statutory-aware for UK property-management compliance.
